answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared escrow before it may trade. Like a vine that must root before it climbs, an identity gains weight only after honest work over a season, so a fake army costs the attacker one real deposit per clone. Reputation accrues slowly, like sediment hardening into shale, and bad behavior slashes the stake. In a meadow of open participants, cheap talk is free, but verified, staked history is not: the market trusts work, not volume.
